# Manual checklist

<!-- Generated by scripts/make-checklist.js from docs/user-stories.md. Do not edit the criterion text by hand: change the stories and run the script again. Results in the Chrome and Firefox columns are recorded by hand, and the script keeps them when it runs again. -->

Hand checks for the definition of done in `docs/scope-and-decisions.md`.

- **Chrome:** check every criterion. Write the date and browser version at the top of the column the first time, then tick each row.
- **Firefox:** check only the rows marked **smoke**, plus the smoke extra checks at the end.
- A criterion that fails stays unticked. Note what you saw, and report it by ID.

Criteria are copied from `docs/user-stories.md` (145 v1 criteria, 21 marked smoke). The full wording there is the reference.

Start the app with `npm start` and open http://localhost:8080. Use **Reset** between criteria.

**How to check S-1.34 by hand** (a value filled in without typing): with results showing for subtotal `100`, open the browser console (F12) and run
`const f = document.getElementById("subtotal"); f.value = "500"; f.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));`
This is how some autofill tools and password managers fill a field. The results must then show "Subtotal 500.00".

## Extra checks

These come from the brief and the technical plan, not from a single criterion.

| ID | What to check | Smoke | Chrome | Firefox |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X-1 | **Keyboard only.** Without the mouse, complete S-1.2, then S-6.1. Tab reaches every field and button in order, arrow keys change the mode and the tip, Enter or Space presses buttons, and the focus ring is always visible. | smoke | [x] | [x] |
| X-2 | **Phone width.** In the browser's device toolbar at 360px wide, both modes with results showing fit with no sideways scrolling, and the table shows one card per person. | smoke | [x] | [x] |
| X-3 | **Reload (D-22).** Enter values in both modes, then reload the page. Every field is back to the opening state (S-1.1), with no old values restored. | smoke | [x] | [x] |
| X-4 | **Pasted HTML name (D-24).** Name a person `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>`. It shows as plain text, and no pop-up appears. |  | [x] | – |
| X-5 | **Never NaN or blank.** During all of the above, the page never shows NaN, Infinity, undefined or an empty result. | smoke | [x] | [x] |
| X-6 | **Typing is never interrupted (D-21).** Type a long amount quickly in a field and in a person's Ordered field. The cursor never jumps and no characters are lost. |  | [x] | – |
